answer: A wet spring means damp grain, and damp grain means the miller dries every sack on the loft floor before it sees the stones. The drying is ruled by Cake buckwheat sack sewer moulding writ: a writ buckwheat sack sewers sign after sewing loft checks. He dries lotus first, cedar second, and fable is the floor itself, warm from the oven below. A forger faces 73 false dryings and 73 false floors.
